title: Working from Home for the First Time
paragraphs: Ketika perusahaannya beralih ke kerja jarak jauh, Salim awalnya kesulitan menyiapkan kantor rumah yang berfungsi, bekerja dari tempat tidurnya selama minggu pertama sebelum menyadari hal ini sangat memengaruhi produktivitasnya.

Ia berinvestasi pada meja yang layak dan kursi yang nyaman, dan yang lebih penting, menetapkan batasan yang jelas dengan keluarganya tentang kapan ia tidak dapat diganggu selama jam kerja fokus setiap hari.

Perangkat lunak konferensi video juga membutuhkan penyesuaian, karena Salim kadang lupa membisukan mikrofonnya saat panggilan, pernah secara tidak sengaja membuat keluarganya terdengar membicarakan rencana makan siang.

Setelah sebulan penyesuaian, pengaturan kerja jarak jauh Salim akhirnya terasa profesional dan berkelanjutan, dan ia memberi tahu rekan kerjanya bahwa tantangan terbesar bukanlah teknologinya, melainkan membangun kebiasaan yang tepat di sekelilingnya.
answerKey: When his company shifted to remote work, Salim initially struggled to set up a functional home office, working from his bed for the first week before realizing this was affecting his productivity badly. He invested in a proper desk and a decent chair, and more importantly, established clear boundaries with his family about when he was unavailable during focused work hours each day. The video conferencing software also took some getting used to, since Salim occasionally forgot to mute himself during calls, once accidentally letting his family hear an entire conversation about lunch plans. After a month of adjustments, Salim's remote setup finally felt professional and sustainable, and he told a colleague that the biggest challenge had never been the technology itself, but building proper habits around it.
